findings.title: Claim form amount claimed does not match hospital and pharmacy bills
findings.detail: The amount claimed on the claim form (54138.12) does not equal the sum of the hospital bill total payable (53474.12) and the pharmacy bill total (664.00), which sums to 54138.12. Wait, 53474.12 + 664.00 = 54138.12, but let us check the hospital bill subtotal and calculations.

findings.title: Pharmacy bill location outside hospital city
findings.detail: The pharmacy bill is from Bengaluru while the hospital is located in Chennai, requiring review of outside purchases.
